about_the_game:
Poligons is a strategy game that rewards players for making decisions quickly. Choose the right shapes and fight.

In Poligons, you must defend your Crystal and summon your units to fight your enemies. Each unit has its own geometric shape and each enemy has its own shape too, use your units against enemies with the same shapes and watch them fight, but if the shape is different they will not interact with each other.

As you complete waves, you receive coins that can be used to purchase upgrades, such as health, damage, attack speed, and several other less generic ones.

Unlock new skills and new Crystals, increase your chance of survival.

Unlock different unique abilities for each Crystal, such as meteors, poisonous mushrooms, and lightning storms. These skills can be purchased with special coins that you only get by killing bosses. The game, being divided into phases, allows for a feeling of gradual progression.
